note: Recommended free local models for the AI Connectors page. DATA downloads this file from GitHub at boot and falls back to the copy bundled with the app. Data only: names, download sizes (GB, default q4 tag) and short descriptions. Local downloadable tags only; Ollama cloud tags are hosted and billed, so they never belong here.

models.label: DeepSeek-R1 1.5B
models.blurb: DeepSeek's reasoning model, distilled small enough for any laptop. Thinks before it answers.

models.label: Qwen3.5 0.8B
